rows.en: Bernst: "...No need to be so wary.
As you can see, I'm unarmed..."
Touya... I can't have you dying."
Touya: "Don't dodge the question! What's your goal?!"
Well, I suppose it can't be helped...
But you and I are 'comrades,' you know."
Bernst: "I'm now acting with a different aim from Dr. Debish.
And you and I share the goal of defeating Vorlia.
On that point, we're in agreement."
I've devoted everything I had as a researcher to Vorlia's
But one day, I learned the truth.
Vorlia was merely a device for integrating humanity's consciousness.
Debish kept even us in the dark about that,
and had us continue the research.
Well, to be honest, I don't like it.
Having my existence erased by force,
Touya: "And you've finally decided to get off your ass now?"
Bernst: "Yes. You may not believe me,
There's no point unless it's revived first.
To do that, a greater amount of emotional energy
'Hatred,' the strongest emotion and the easiest to create,
was what I induced and accumulated.
Our ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mechs were temporary vessels for it.
Armored Mechs and Spirit Mechs change their output with Prana
because they imitate machines that can turn people's will and emotions into energy:
Celica: "...Spirit Mechs were based on Rayblade,
and the machine that Armored Mechs were based on no longer exists.
And you waited until now to act so you wouldn't repeat the failure of 109 years ago...
This time, I can finally put it into practice myself..."
data in the first place? And 'finally do it yourself'...?
You sound like you knew from the start."
Bernst: "Oh dear. I seem to have let that slip.
Yes, you're right. I knew Wenimas and Lenis
Bernst: "After all, having the data fall into their hands
Making it look 'natural' was quite a job."
Bernst: "A heart... I lost that long ago..."
Bernst: "Thanks to that, you were born in this era.
you're using your talents to the fullest...
Don't you think it's all the work of 'fate'?
That I jumped 2 years before the other four,
and was able to prepare everything too?"
Touya: "...Bernst. I said it before, but even temporarily,
I won't join forces with you."
Fighting Vorlia means fighting Debish too.
I'm offering to help you in that fight.
If my Gaiozon works with your Rayblade,
your chances of victory will improve.
Besides, I gain nothing by lying here and now."
Touya: "Whatever you say, I won't do it.
Sure, if we worked together like you say,
But I haven't fought this far on probabilities
It's a shame, but I'll give up on that. Then, after defeating you,
I'll put my own plans into action."
Bernst: "Hehehe... No, I'll withdraw for today.
Next time we meet, let's settle it.
You and I. Trust and logic. Which is right...?"
Bernst: "Oh, right. There's someone I'd like you
Bernst: "...A girl. You fought her just now, didn't you?"
Bernst: "Yes. Her name is Leone Debish..."
Touya: "You'll tell us why, won't you?"
Bernst: "Because she opposed her father's actions."
controlled her consciousness and forced her
Of course, I was the one who did it just now.
I was testing whether you were worthy of being entrusted with her.
And you stopped her, just as I expected.
That's why I'm telling you now."
Celica: "...So, she's just in your way?"
Bernst: "Hehehe... If I took her back now,
even if I beat you, she'd be Dr. Debish's
Creating more enemies for myself would be a nuisance.
Well, if you don't want her, that's fine.
She'll just be controlled again and appear before you."
Bernst: "Thank you. Sorry for the trouble,
but I'll leave her to you. Oh, and about 'her'...
She's in quite an unstable state right now."
Bernst: "You'll have to see for yourself.
But I'll give you one warning.
There are two ways to stop her.
The other is to wake her up.
By a method passed down since ancient times."
Touya: "There you go being vague again...
What does any of that mean?
Bernst: "Oh, I believe there was a fairy tale in your world
it was called Sleeping in the Forest... Something..."
Bernst: "Yes, that. She wakes with the prince's kiss.
I'll be waiting at Alterias Valley, the site of our final battle..."
Valga: "But if you keep doing things like that,
it's dangerous. Your body's only recently become a pilot's.
Touya: "But we could protect everyone because you were there... Thanks."
Touya: "A girl like this is with ≪Ze=Ode≫...?"
Yamato: "If Bernst was going to leave her, I'd have liked Eleana
Touya: "Yeah. But he probably took it away because
having us analyze it would be a problem..."
This is the first time we've met in person."
Touya: "H-Hey, seriously...? She dented the wall...
A hit like that would kill me!"
Touya: "But how do we stop her like this?!"
Yamato: "A kiss! Remember? The sleeping beauty was awakened
Touya: "Urgh... How can a girl be this strong...?"
Yamato: "Come on, Touya! Hurry, or she'll
Yamato: "Touya! You're a man, aren't you?!
Touya: "Oh, all right! I get it!
I'll kiss her or whatever it takes!"
Yamato: "A-Anyway, now's your chance, while she's down!"
Touya: "No, listen, this is... Hey, Yama..."
Leone: "Wh-What?! What are you trying to do to me?!"
Rishuna: "...And that's why Touya is innocent."
I thought Touya had finally lost all self-control..."
Touya: "Enjoy making me out to be a criminal?"
Ai: "Well, if that's what happened, I suppose it couldn't be helped.
But couldn't you have found another way?"
Touya: "How should I know? Yamato egged me on..."
Leone: "...I see. I've been thrown away..."
Ai: "That's taking it to an extreme. But are you really
Leone: "...Yes. But I was Eleana's experimental pilot.
I don't know any of the details."
Kasumi: "Then won't he come after us himself
Leone: "I... Think we'll be all right...
Because I seem to be in the way..."
Ai: "Come to think of it, you were against Debish's project,
Leone: "Yes... I don't think integrating humanity as disembodied consciousness
I don't think anyone wants it..."
Kasumi: "But would he hate his own daughter just for that?"
Leone: "...I don't know. But even before I opposed them,
Father and my sister avoided me...
No. It was more like they weren't
interested in me. Even being treated harshly would have been
they praise me when an experiment succeeds. My sister too..."
Leone: "Please, stop Father and the others.
I can't let them do that... Please."
Touya: "Why do you care that much...?"
Leone: "Because we're family, related by blood.
...Even if they hate me, that bond will never disappear.
It's the only thing I know for certain won't change..."
Clovis: "...Talking to her like this, she's just like
Were you really fighting in Eleana?"
Leone: "...Hmm... Actually, I don't remember much.
I just have a feeling I was desperately calling for help,
Clovis: "Aha. And that was the prince over there."
Touya: "W-Well, she did say something about helping her
Does it hurt? I'm ridiculously strong..."
Ai: "Whatever the circumstances, you forced a kiss on a girl.
You deserved at least that much!"
Debish: "...That Bernst. Playing clever little games..."
Debish: "No. It seems he's willing to fight now.
Let's make full use of him."
Sharl: "Those people... How long do you intend
to keep them by your side?"
We have Gadrans, but not an endless supply.
They can at least serve as cannon fodder."
Well, yes. She's useful. In various ways..."
Valga: "...Well, what do we do now?
I'd suggest going to the place that Bernst
Touya: "Oh, right. He did say something like that.
Emy: "It's a valley northwest of here."
Fain: "Hey, Second. Hasn't that valley ever been
Emy: "...Well, this is information from the enemy, so
we can't be too certain. But at present,
The Sorge Field is formed over Alterias Valley,
so there are few ways to get inside."
I hadn't noticed at all. Hohohoho!"
We won't get anywhere like this."
Fain: "Whoa! L-Let go! Damn it, let go!"
Derock: "You'll need a lot more training
Fain: "Grrraah! You'll pay for this, Second..."
Ai: "...How nice. They seem so close."
Ymir: "We don't understand it in detail,
but it's a kind of barrier. The greater the mass,
the harder it is to enter that airspace."
But why was a place that obviously suspicious
Ymir: "A person might get in, but something with an Armored Mech's mass
You wouldn't think anyone could get in there."
Celica: "We can't rule it out... No, they're probably high."
but this time, our opponent will definitely be Debish himself.
We need to be fully prepared."
The Spirit Mechs need repairs, and more importantly,
you need to recover from the exhaustion of
we'll probably only get one chance.
and prepares for tomorrow. All right?"
Ai: "...Oh, right. What about that girl?"
I'll take responsibility for looking after her."
You don't intend to leave her sleeping in the infirmary like that?"
Ymir: "Then shall she come home with us?
Ivel: "Yes. I'll leave her to you, then."
You need to eat plenty while you're young.
Honey, she can't eat if you keep staring."
Even a man would have trouble eating that much... Ow, ow, ow!"
Paldia: "Don't mind him. Eat as much as you like.
If it's not enough, I'll make more right away."
Forzen: "Exactly. Don't hold back at all.
When someone enjoys it this much,
cooking is worth the effort, isn't it?"
Melvi: "Melvi's going to eat lots too!"
Forzen: "All right! Daddy won't lose to you!"
What's she doing up at this hour?"
Touya: "...Hey. What are you doing up so late?"
Today was so much fun. That's why..."
Touya: "Fun? It was normal... Well, maybe not.
They're all good people, except Forzen."
warm family. I've never had a meal that much fun.
Even after being treated like that, you still want to stop them?"
Leone: "Yes. That's what family is, isn't it?
But... Maybe what we had earlier, that feeling around the table,
Touya: "...When it hurts, you can say it hurts.
If you want, I'll listen anytime."
Leone: "Oh... I'd like to talk a little longer..."
Leone: "Then just a little longer. Please?"
Leone: "This way, I won't catch a cold.
And... I don't want to be alone..."
Touya: "W-Well, if you're happy like this, I don't mind..."
